role: Computes bidirectional SIMILAR_TO edges between newly ingested instance nodes and existing nodes sharing the same label_raw, using cosine similarity of embeddings.
detail: SimilarityComputer is the main class responsible for computing pairwise cosine similarity between a new instance node and all existing instance-level nodes within the same label_raw scope after Layer 2 ingests observations. It creates bidirectional SIMILAR_TO edges when similarity meets or exceeds a configurable threshold (default 0.65, stored in a MetaSchema config node). Core algorithm: _cosine_similarity() computes dot product normalized by vector magnitudes, returning [-1.0, 1.0] or 0.0 for zero-magnitude vectors. Edge IDs are deterministic (similar-{source}-to-{target}) enabling idempotent upserts. Threshold is cached after first load to avoid repeated graph reads. Provenance on SIMILAR_TO edges is always INFERENCE with confidence equal to the cosine similarity score.
gotchas: Threshold changes require process restart; no hot-reload (Phase 1 limitation). Self-edges never created. Nodes without valid list embedding property are silently skipped. Score clamped to [0.0, 1.0] to absorb floating-point overshoot. Cosine similarity function intentionally duplicated rather than imported from test-double module to avoid inverted dependencies.
